en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 9.  Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.) said, “One who murders someone, the Almighty Allah will write all the sins of the victim in the name of his murderer and cleanse the victim.
This is described the verse: Surely  I  wish  that  you  should bear the sin committed against me and your own sin, and so you would be of the inmates of the fire.”
